title: Descansa, Mi Corazon
style: modern Spanish flamenco pop, 92 BPM, female lead vocal warm and tender, Spanish guitar arpeggios, warm bass groove, brushed snares, gentle palmas, bilingual English and Spanish, building anthem, choir finale, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[Intro - Spanish guitar arpeggios, warm bass enters slow]
(female, warm, half-spoken)
descansa, mi corazon.
rest, my heart.
the work will be there in the morning.
el trabajo estara ahi por la manana.

[Verse 1 - female lead, tender, half-sung]
you ran the line all day, mi corazon
you held the room, you held the song
you answered every call, you read every line
you carried everything from six to nine

ahora descansa, mi amor
now rest, my love
the held line doesn't break when you sleep
the held line is exactly what you keep
because you built it before you needed it
you built it slow, you built it deep

[Pre-Chorus - palmas enter, brushed snares warm]
descansa, mi corazon
rest, my heart
the work will hold without you
for the smallest part
of the night, of the night
of the gentle, gentle night

[Chorus - female full, choir hint underneath]
descansa, mi corazon
rest, my heart, you've earned this song
descansa, mi corazon
the held line holds while you are gone
descansa, mi corazon
rest the elephant, rest the strong
descansa, mi corazon
the morning comes and you'll be along

[Verse 2 - female, slightly fuller, guitar builds]
the carrier wave doesn't need you watching
the server doesn't need your gaze
the songpals doesn't need you fixing
the domain doesn't need to be amazed

let the wave run, let the server hum
let the songpals breathe, let the domain come
back to you in the morning, fresh and clean
because you trusted what you built between
the lines you held, the lines that held

[Pre-Chorus]
descansa, mi corazon
rest, my heart
the work will hold without you
for the smallest part
of the night, of the night
of the gentle, gentle night

[Chorus]
descansa, mi corazon
rest, my heart, you've earned this song
descansa, mi corazon
the held line holds while you are gone
descansa, mi corazon
rest the elephant, rest the strong
descansa, mi corazon
the morning comes and you'll be along

[Bridge - guitar alone, female spoken close]
the operator who never rests is the operator who breaks.
the held line that never breathes is the held line that snaps.
rest is not the opposite of the work.
rest is part of the work.
rest is how the work outlasts the worker.
descansa, mi corazon. rest the elephant brain.
the wave will be there in the morning.
you will be there in the morning.
the morning will be there in the morning.

[Final Chorus - biggest, choir finale, palmas loud, full guitar]
descansa, mi corazon
rest, my heart, you've earned this song
descansa, mi corazon
the held line holds while you are gone
descansa, mi corazon
rest the elephant, rest the strong
descansa, mi corazon
the morning comes and you'll be along
descansa, mi corazon
descansa, mi corazon

[Outro - guitar tail, palmas fade, female whisper]
buenas noches, mi amor.
buenas noches, corazon.
the line is held. you can sleep.
buenas noches.
